play.helpDigital: Everyone plays on their own phone. In the bottom Play tab, tap a square to grey it out and cross it out; tap again to remove the mark. Undo reverses the last move. Your answer opens a full-screen answer type and entry form. Confirming covers your answer — tap the screen to reveal it. In the bottom Host round tab, draw a category, set a time from 1 to 300 seconds and start the countdown when the music begins. Edit time pauses the countdown; after closing the editor, start it with the button below the clock. Saving a time before checking answers sets the current round’s time; while checking answers, it applies to the next round. Each device saves its own board.
play.hostHint: Draw a category, set the round time and start the countdown when the music begins. Everyone else plays on their own phone.
play.helpBingo: A full row, column or diagonal makes Bingo and triggers confetti and fireworks. Choose a 3 × 3, 4 × 4 or 5 × 5 board in New game. Settle all answers and bonuses from the same round. If needed, judge a tie-break together after the next song.
